patterns.name: Search · inspect · compare
patterns.loop: Choose where to look, reveal a clue, compare conditions, explain a useful next move.
patterns.spiral: Habitat need → changed condition → survey/classification → supporting field note.
patterns.limits: Supplied pictures are not field identification or independent scientific observation.

patterns.name: Assemble · allocate · check
patterns.loop: Meet a request with limited materials; count, share, substitute and revise.
patterns.spiral: Equal plates → fractions of a recipe → measured ingredients → prices/change/budgets.
patterns.limits: Matching pretend food preferences does not assess empathy, nutrition or financial judgment.

patterns.name: Change · measure · explain
patterns.loop: Predict, change one thing, run or observe, compare records, explain the limits.
patterns.spiral: Model distance → repeated trials/graphs → water/soil study → energy/sound/light.
patterns.limits: Water Lab includes authored explanations and a manually stepped invented closed water-path machine. Models are not physical measurements; real soil, rainfall rates and runoff measurements remain absent.

patterns.name: Read · infer · support
patterns.loop: Read or hear a meaningful message; find the clue, infer a purpose, identify supporting words.
patterns.spiral: Explicit note → sequence → inference → compare accounts → evaluate conflicting sources.
patterns.limits: Comprehension selections, narration and additional-language reading do not establish independent decoding or first-language reading level.

patterns.name: Compose · execute · revise
patterns.loop: Make a message or sequence, let a reader/runner respond literally, revise for the intended effect.
patterns.spiral: Word-card directions → branching instructions → short messages → longer authored explanations.
patterns.limits: Finite tap-to-compose clauses are distinct from free writing, handwriting and general programming.

patterns.name: Build · transform · relate
patterns.loop: Make an object/model, transform it, connect its representation to a relation or explanation.
patterns.spiral: Counters/bundles → arrays/inverse relations → fractions/area → algebraic structures.
patterns.limits: A successful answer does not establish recall, fluent calculation or use of an unreported strategy.

patterns.name: Create · perform · reflect
patterns.loop: Make something expressive, try or share it, notice its effect, choose a revision.
patterns.spiral: Rhythm/shape/voice experiment → a composition → explain or perform a revision.
patterns.limits: Story Loft supports open puppet composition, performance and revision. Reviewed sound/phoneme instruction is not built. Artistic preference, authored words and personal reflection are not numeric attainment scores.

games.name: Number Garden and open math models
games.scope: Seven authored math areas with variants, editable models and optional explanations; sparse task evidence stays separate from placement.

games.name: Multiplication Garden
games.scope: Ordered facts through 12×12 with counting, derivation, help and method distinctions; no timing-based recall certification.

games.name: Living Garden
games.scope: Nine habitat settings, three separately suggested depths in science/notes/math, renewable sealed café parcels. Original visit retained. Optional Life Stages (spec65, #living/stages) uses four original Small White butterfly diagrams and eight next/before chart-neighbour tasks, separating stage position from same-individual/offspring meaning. A supplied named-species chart, not field observation, independent retelling or general insect-life-cycle attainment. Optional Food Links (spec66, #living/food) looks up two named sap/aphid/larval-predator feeding links from either endpoint and interprets a supplied food-to-eater energy legend. Supplied diagrams/facts, not field observation, full diets, independent explanation or a complete food web.

games.name: Almost-Right Café
games.scope: Silly ingredient constraints, equal plates, stock shortfall and real inventory; welcome-back dinner/New Game Plus. No assessed money or empathy curriculum.

games.name: Cloud Orchard and gathering hunts
games.scope: Find pretend foods using authored clues/row-column hunts and harvest quantities. Not botanical identification.

games.name: Storm Workshop
games.scope: Controlled ramp/surface model, repeatable authored distances, table and zero-based bars. Not calibrated physics or independent experimental design.

games.name: Water Lab
games.scope: Three authored melting/warming/evaporation missions and molecule pictures tied to the flooded path. Controlled runoff remains planned.

games.name: Willow Post Office
games.scope: Six authored packing orders, editable literal word-card routes, manual flight, revisions, optional reading reports. Optional three-note reader-revision desk connects to a separate Story Loft rehearsal; exact original wording is human-read, not automatically evaluated. A continuing twelve-letter round varies readers and purposes with open message-structure suggestions; old notes and authored drafts remain separate.

games.name: Bramble’s ribbon gate
games.scope: Renewable adaptive +/−/× ribbon tasks, full ordered 12×12 pool, separate examples/decomposition. A component of Post Office, not a separate world.

games.name: English Paris
games.scope: Authored repeatable stories, vocabulary, sequence, inference and evidence selections, with local support and familiarity distinctions.

games.name: French Paris
games.scope: Separate French stories and reading suggestions. No transfer of English decoding or proficiency labels; French is outside Marble’s English organization.

games.name: Word Garden
games.scope: Finite prefix/suffix constructions, authored scenes, spelling exceptions and open discussion. Encounters are not independent reading or spelling evidence. Published with the complete game on Cloudflare.

games.name: Story Loft puppet theatre
games.scope: Compose one to twelve pictured scenes with optional puppet dialogue, perform manually and revise for an audience. Supplied captions, authored words and open discussion do not establish independent writing, reading or retelling proficiency. A separate two-turn reader rehearsal carries a delivery note, with optional authored motive/reply and literal supplied-card comparison; existing shows are preserved. A continuing twelve-letter round varies readers and purposes with open message-structure suggestions; old notes and authored drafts remain separate.

games.name: Growing shelf: seedling investigation
games.scope: Invented adequate/dim-light cress illustrations across four days; unscored predictions, copied observation rows, observation/explanation and height-only contrasts, supplied water-test choice, frozen evidence beside planting plans. Not measured biology, independent measurement, experimental design or full plant-growth coverage.

games.name: Field Notebook: choose and chart
games.scope: Eight same-day model comparisons: choose useful rows, build editable fixed-zero-baseline bars, distinguish draft reading from source fidelity and question relevance, keep unfinished/revised charts. Invented stem-mm source, supplied scale, visible-source practice; no independent measurement, chart-scale choice or real growth conclusion.

games.name: The Sharing Counter
games.scope: Six open pictured picnic requests: repair equal rectangular halves/quarters, compare same-whole half/two-quarter portions, share twelve identical buns into four equal groups and pack one/three groups. Exact accumulated strip/line is supplied explanation; all checks visual practice, no physical measurement or independent fraction proficiency claim.

games.name: Rain Paths: follow a tabletop machine
games.scope: Four matched invented closed-machine comparisons, manually stepped arbitrary water tokens, changed-factor and relevant-column questions, optional differences and a copied runoff route with a finite holding cup and overflow. Not measured hydrology, physical experimental design, water-cycle coverage or a flood-safety result.

games.name: The Measuring Kitchen
games.scope: Six fictional two-ingredient trays: fill/read a straight-sided 500 mL jug in 50 mL steps, choose a volume unit, pour into separate labelled preparation jars and return portions. Numeric reading, unit naming, recipe fit and empty-jug readiness stay separate. Supported picture measurement only; no physical-tool competence, mass, litre conversion, mixing or recipe scaling.

games.name: Travelers’ Archive: Paris,1910
games.scope: One reviewed Paris1910 visit: real credited CC0 photograph, modern original chronology summaries, schematic place matching, ordinal date ordering, finite source-scope/interpretation choices and ungraded local reply. Production date is distinct from exact scene date; no citywide recovery, independent research/decoding or French-proficiency claim.

games.name: Rain Paths charts: a carried result
games.scope: Freeze one actual completed current or kept machine result, choose useful counts and construct editable two-bar charts on a fixed 0–24 model-token scale. Draft reading, source fidelity and original runoff questions remain separate. Four finite sources; no measured hydrology, independent scale choice or learning-level inference.

games.name: Fraction Trail
games.scope: Six open length-number-line requests on a fixed 0–2 ribbon: edit partitions, step a flag along actual boundaries, separately check spaces, requested stop and raw reading; keep frozen unfinished route cards. Half/quarter/sixth comparison and one five-quarter encounter only; all model-visible practice, no independent mastery or area/set/decimal coverage.

games.name: Bundle Burrow: Exchange Table
games.scope: Seven fixed collections from 0 to 42, with countable wrapped tens, loose ones and a ten-place frame. Exact reversible conserved exchanges; distinct wrapped-count, total, tens-digit and tens-value forms; frozen unfinished keeps and separate 16 example. Supplied numeral/model practice, no handwriting, arbitrary-range counting, arithmetic algorithm or general place-value proficiency claim.

games.name: Instructions for a Reader
games.scope: Two original short instruction cases shared with #loft/instructions. Separate picture plan, supplied A/B sentence strip and exact human-read words; finite manual scene consequences, optional reader questions/reports and bounded kept versions. Supplied assembly and guided revision opportunity only; no arbitrary-language parsing, independent composition/decoding/handwriting, listening or programming proficiency claim.

games.name: Fair Test Bench
games.scope: Choose both setups in the original finite ramp model; distinguish question-relevant, wrong-factor, identical and confounded pairs; reveal up to three examples per side, inspect repeats and keep an ungraded claim or exact note. Authored model comparison practice only; no physical investigation, causal-proof, independent measurement or mastery claim. Optional Moss encounters (spec60) preserve a valid observation while repairing a causal overclaim or recognising a careful statement; demonstration, supplied explanation and exact ungraded prose stay separate. This adds no independently observed teaching-back attainment.

games.name: Market Day Coin Counter
games.scope: Payment mode: four supplied US-cent denominations, count versus value, conserved exchanges and two alternative exact payments across eight pretend stall requests. Optional Market Change (spec67, #workshop/change): six fixed price/tender cases, independent coverage and returned-response choices, explicit zero versus shortage, and any fitting coin composition. Frozen historical checks stay separate. No unlabelled real-coin recognition, UK notation, dollars, budgets, scarcity or monetary Café economy.

games.name: Cartographer’s Table
games.scope: Freely place four keyed landmarks on a supplied0–5 intersection grid; read horizontal-first coordinates and compose two adjacent orthogonal routes. Count travelled intervals in fictional model metres, including retraced segments; compare frozen checks separately from revised maps. Supported schematic practice only; no real geography, surveying, physical scale, rates, independent axis construction or full coordinate/geometry attainment. Optional three supplied delivery jobs add freely revealable Map-reader/Dispatcher/Both clue views and child-authored routes through an intermediate stop. Recorded arrival, actual stop visit and serving the request remain separate; no secure separation, partner participation or communication attainment is inferred. Optional structured authoring (spec63) chooses start, collection and final delivery on a complete free map, then creates a separate frozen solving job after a supplied 12-move feasibility check. Generated wording and displayed calculations do not establish independent writing, shortest-path reasoning or general problem-posing attainment.

games.name: Two Windows
games.scope: Three original fictional events with two tellers and freely chosen short/long passages. Distinguish explicit, inferred, contradicted and missing details across both accounts, select supporting lines, and choose a supplied revision for a particular reader. Optional exact own words remain ungraded; no decoding, independent writing, general narrator reliability or historical corroboration claim.

games.name: Balance Stall
games.scope: An ideal equal-arm model with identical one-unit masses: compare two different visible arrangements, make reversible paired/one-sided changes and explore one whole sealed parcel of fixed model mass. Proposed value, isolation, performed actions, support and frozen outcomes stay separate. No physical measurement, two-step/general equation solving or independently demonstrated method claim.

Light slice only: inspect explicitly invented already-emerged cress seedlings under adequate versus too-little light, with supplied controls. No measured growth dataset, species-wide light rule or full plant-requirements coverage.

Copy selected finite model observations into a labelled table, preserving day, condition, specimen and millimetres. This is supplied-row collecting; independently choosing useful data, measuring and constructing charts remain planned.

Two finite model questions distinguish a pictured length from a proposed cause and compare stem length with leaf/stem features. Model observation versus interpretation practice, not a real-world causal experiment.
Choose between two supplied proposed water comparisons: hold light and other conditions alike, or confound light and water. No water results or independent experimental-design claim.

Choose up to two supplied observations relevant to a day/specimen question, retain source labels and exact units, and revise a selection. This extends copied-row collecting; no physical data gathering or measurement claim.

Table-to-labelled-two-bar presentation of invented source observations. The pinned title is misleading; its description supports a narrow recording/presentation slice. No living-things classification key or independent field survey claim.

Construct exact numerical bars on a supplied shared 0–70 scale with 10-unit ticks, choose quantity/unit labels and compare two categories. Distinguish reading an inaccurate draft from source agreement and question relevance. No independent scale choice, pictogram, time-series graph or full-topic claim.
Repair a rectangular two-piece cut into equal halves; unequal widths remain editable and are not called halves.
Repair rectangular cuts into four equal-width quarters, distinguish equality from merely counting four pieces.
Partition only uniform rectangles into equal halves/quarters; circles and other shapes remain missing.
Manually step through supplied identical wholes showing one half and two quarters; compare learner-selected portions without independent equivalence assessment.
One or three quarters of a twelve-bun whole, using four supplied group mats. No general fraction-of-amount strategy or unlike whole comparison.
Make four equal groups of three from twelve identical tokens; pack one/three complete groups while retaining the original whole.
Reversible one-at-a-time/one-each bun sharing into four supplied mats. Grouping remains visible; full twelve-bun scope only.
A fixed 0–1 line and accumulation strip derive the amount of selected equal loaf pieces, including separated quarters. No independent marker placement or scale selection.

Identify the one supplied difference between matched tabletop machines: open versus sealed entrance, or starting stored tokens. Controls remain visible; no independent physical test planning/carrying-out.
Choose newly-stored/new-runoff columns relevant to where the new tokens went; keep exact supplied counts and copied route results. No real measurement, free data collection or graph construction.
Supplied prompts distinguish visible token counts from authored machine rules, with optional unrecorded conversation. No automatically checked causal explanation or real hydrologic evidence.

Use a supplied standard-unit mL scale, retain a numeric reading and compare exact fictional volumes. No capacity estimation, physical tools or other unit choice instruction beyond a finite mL/g/items contrast.
Read a straight-sided graduated 500 mL picture jug with ten 50 mL intervals, fill and reversibly transfer liquid portions. Other measures and independent practical measuring remain absent.
Compare each same-unit preparation amount with its recipe target and optionally inspect needed additions/returns. No conversions, mass or general multistep measure problems.
Read supplied creator/date/source-kind labels and distinguish object production date from an unestablished exact scene time. No independent archival sourcing or inferred creator motive.
Compare the scope of one period photo and a modern chronology, including what they cannot corroborate. These are not two independent eyewitness confirmations.
Finite contrasts separate visible local detail, catalogue date, modern summary and a limited peak-before-return inference. No full historical-argument or citywide conclusion.
Select the supplied photo, chronology or neither for a specific question, then choose evidence/limits for a prepared reply. No broad research proficiency or automatically evaluated original writing.
Select and organise completed model counts relevant to a supplied runoff question. No new real measurement or independent data collection.
Present carried machine counts as two labelled bars and compare the draft with its frozen source. No living-thing classification or full scientific presentation claim.

Construct bars against a supplied four-token tick scale; distinguish reading the entered chart from source fidelity and compare two runoff counts. No independent scale choice, pictograms or broad graph proficiency.
Build and read a flag location on a fixed 0–2 length line. Supplied whole/scale and visible model; no independent scale selection or full fraction-number topic coverage.
Edit equal/unequal first-whole partitions, repeat those same spaces in the second whole and step only along actual boundaries. Fixed12-tick coordinate model, six authored cases.
Name an actual flag with whole or fraction notation, separating a correct location reading from the requested stop/partition. One five-quarter encounter; no general mixed-number or area/set work.
Keep a half-length route and compare a current two-quarter/three-sixth route at the same physical scale. Half family only, no general equivalence/simplification strategy.
Read/write bounded whole or numerator/denominator notation for an actual visible flag; equivalents accepted. No general symbolic fluency or independent reading proficiency inference.

Count thirteen pictured counters, move ten to a frame and wrap/unwrap the same ten with three outside; a separate supplied sixteen example revisits the action. Only these two teens, not all teen numerals or handwriting.

Wrap exactly ten frame counters into one visibly ten-marked bundle and unwrap into an empty ten-place frame. Fixed totals conserved with reversible one-counter moves; containers add no counters. No arbitrary packing capacity or physical exchange inference.

Distinguish actual wrapped bundles from a supplied numeral’s tens digit and tens-place value for selected quantities 0,7,13,20,27,30,42, including noncanonical grouping. Zero/seven have no written tens digit; empty tens place is supplied. No full two-digit range, independent decoding or written arithmetic claim.

Arrange up to three supplied actions in two fixed scenes, inspect missing/out-of-order consequences and manually reveal a computer’s finite rules. One note/envelope premise and one newcomer/preparation case; not general programming or arbitrary natural-language execution.

Make an independent picture plan, optionally rehearse off-screen, then explicitly assemble supplied sentences or write exact ungraded words. Plan and both drafts stay separate; no observed oral sentence production, independent prose or narrative beginning/middle/end claim.

Read an exact draft with a person, invite clarification, preserve a comment tied to that text and compare explicit versions. A guided opportunity; no automatic reader-comprehension, prose-quality, proofreading or learning judgment.

Name the reader’s knowledge and this note’s purpose; optionally compare a supplied preparation instruction with an invitation to watch, plus a newcomer/familiar-reader discussion. Supplied form/purpose contrast only; full tone/register/genre choice remains outside this slice.

Independently choose A/B height and surface settings for one of two supplied questions; explain whether neither, one relevant, one other or both factors change. Narrow finite-model design practice; no general physical experimental competence.

Choose which finite model trials to reveal, inspect a labelled A/B table and shared ruler, and notice unequal repetitions or observed variation. Automatic recording is supported data reading, not independent measurement or table construction.

Keep frozen stopping distances separate from a provisional claim and exact optional words, with a supplied explanation of what a confounded comparison cannot establish. Prose and physical causal reasoning remain ungraded.
Four labelled schematic US coins with supplied names/cent values and a size-versus-value contrast. US-cent adaptation only; source UK coins/notes and independent real-coin recognition are not met.

Construct two different US-cent coin vectors for one marked amount and exchange denominations while conserving value. Separate physical coin count from cents. The source description concerns combinations; giving change and UK-specific evidence remain outside this slice.
Read supplied horizontal-first ordered pairs and place labelled landmarks on intersections0–5. The grid/key are supplied; shape vertices and independent explanation remain unobserved.

Supplied perpendicular axes with origin(0,0), across-first/up-second coordinate labels and a(4,2) versus(2,4) talking invitation. The bundled generic title describes a coordinate system; no independent axis construction or wider attainment.
Author fictional landmark positions and interpret two route endpoints on a bounded first-quadrant point grid. No time/distance data graph, negative coordinates or physical map survey.

Count every travelled unit segment, including retracing, with1 fictional model metre per interval; distinguish six point markers from five intervals. No physical ruler or real-object measurement claim.

Compare two original fictional tellers with different access to one event. Noticing, time and visibility change available details; no first/third-person classification, authorial intent or general reliability attainment.

Classify supplied statements across both fictional accounts, combining authored supporting line sets. Distinguish inference, explicit contradiction and missing information; supplied selections do not establish independent reading or general evidence evaluation.

Choose between supplied revisions in response to a fictional reader’s specific question. Exact own words can be kept for a human reader but are ungraded; no claim of independent revision or broad writing-feedback proficiency.

Body clues (#living/bodies, local build): compare jointed walking legs plus a second feature on four supplied adult diagrams. Ladybird is a beetle; no universal six-leg converse, life-stage rule, spider practice, real field identification or whole-topic attainment.

Body clues (#living/bodies, local build): follow a supplied four-picture two-feature key, retain uncertainty and revise a trail. Not creating keys, identifying unfamiliar organisms outdoors, independent decoding or full evidence coverage.

Relational equals through two supplied noncanonical grouped arrangements and reversible one-sided/paired unit-mass changes. Actual unequal relations stay visible; no independently composed explanation or general symbolic proof.

One fixed whole-parcel model mass plus loose unit masses equals a known total, including a right-side parcel. Proposed value stays separate from performed paired changes and an isolated level balance. No all-form unknown equation, two-step or general algebra attainment.

Life Stages (#living/stages, local build): four supplied Small White stages, eight directed chart-neighbour questions and same-individual versus offspring choices. Guided partial ordering/continuity practice, not independent explanation, retelling/drawing, field observation or full-topic attainment.

Food Links (#living/food, local build): four supplied endpoint questions over broad bean sap → black bean aphid → seven-spot ladybird larva; neighbour and food-arrow energy meaning assessed separately. Guided partial minibeast feeding practice, not independent chain construction/explanation, field identification, full diets or whole-topic attainment.
